Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software
Cognizant Romania is home to 2400+ creative technologists and is one of Eastern Europe's largest Software Product Engineering delivery networks. We serve global clients in several industries, including Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communication Media & Technology, and Retail & MLEU (manufacturing, logistics, energy & utilities).
 Our product thinking mindset defines, builds, and launches new, experience-centered software products that reinvent business.
 Cognizant Romania was established in 2018 when Cognizant acquired Softvision, a company founded in the late 1990s in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We continue to build on our history as the preferred engineering partner for thriving Silicon Valley tech companies, now as a prominent Cognizant next generation studio.
 We are looking for exceptional Senior iOS Engineers to work with our cross-functional team and join our world-class community of talented experts in Romania.
 We are looking for an experienced Senior iOS Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of high-quality mobile applications used at scale.
 What you’ll do 
Design, develop and maintain iOS applications and new mobile features
Build clean, testable and maintainable code using Swift and/or Objective-C 
Develop modern user experiences using UIKit and SwiftUI 
Solve complex technical challenges and continuously improve application performance and stability
Contribute to mobile architecture, frameworks and engineering best practices
Collaborate closely with Product, Design and Engineering teams
Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing activities
Evaluate new technologies and approaches that can improve development efficiency and product quality
 What we’re looking for 
 8+ years of experience in iOS/mobile development 
Strong hands-on experience with Swift and/or Objective-C 
Very good understanding of design patterns and SOLID principles 
Strong knowledge of UIKit and SwiftUI 
Experience with networking, data persistence and custom UI components
Good understanding of source control, code review and CI/CD practices
Experience with automated testing and writing maintainable, testable code
Proactive mindset and interest in continuously improving mobile engineering practices
Good spoken and written English
 Tech environment 
 Mobile: Swift, Objective-C, UIKit, SwiftUI
 Cloud & Infrastructure: GCP, Cloud Run, Memorystore, Cloud SQL
 CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code: GitHub Actions, Terraform
 Testing: Jest, JUnit
 Cognizant Romania Employee Benefits: 
 Flexible Work Schedule – Outside of core working hours, you have the flexibility to arrange your schedule in a way that best suits your personal and professional needs.
 Flexible Hybrid Approach – We support a hybrid working model that helps you balance remote and office work. Employees based near a Cognizant office are expected to spend a minimum of 4 days per month onsite.
 Annual Leave – Enjoy 26 vacation days each year to relax, recharge, travel, and spend quality time with family and friends.
 Learning & Development – Access a wide range of training programs, workshops, certifications, and continuous learning opportunities to support your professional growth.
 Private Medical Insurance – Comprehensive healthcare coverage for your wellbeing and peace of mind.
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential professional support services to help you navigate personal, emotional, financial, legal, or work-related challenges.
 Meal Tickets – Monthly meal allowance provided through meal vouchers.
 Referral Bonus Program – Help us grow our team and be rewarded for successful referrals.
 Life Insurance – Additional protection and financial security
 Banking Benefits – Preferential banking services and financial products through our partner institutions.
 Bookster Library – Access thousands of books, audiobooks, and learning resources to support both personal and professional development.
 Please note that only suitable candidates will be contacted. Cognizant and its affiliated companies are firmly committed to protecting your privacy. This Candidate Privacy Notice provides you with all the details on what we do with Personal Information we collect during and after the recruitment process.
